scope: Forty fixed staff questions at unchanged source scope, engine, delivery and resource budgets; no model or network calls
baseline: Run node scripts/build_evidence_workbench.mjs --explorer-root <matching-explorer-checkout> --check in the DWP feature worktree.
candidate_scratch: Create a disposable copy-on-write checkout from the DWP review worktree with the same frozen source inventory. Copy scripts/passage_boundary_parser.py over scratch/scripts/manual_structure.py and scripts/manual_navigation_regions.py over the matching scratch path. These are the only producer substitutions; the retained manifest and report bind their exact hashes.

Run scratch/.venv/bin/python scripts/build_structured_units.py, then build_structured_context.py, then build_evidence_connect.py, then node scripts/build_evidence_workbench.mjs --explorer-root <matching-explorer-checkout>.
The structural-unit manifest must have 54,577 units and its record shards and decoded document hashes must equal evaluation/passage-boundary-candidate/structured-units/manifest.json.

If a scratch rerun encounters the projection surplus guard, move only generated scratch evidence-connect outputs or .DS_Store files aside, then repeat the unchanged producer. The guard was encountered during this replay and was not disabled.
limits: The replay measures selected evidence, page overlap, omissions and delivery bytes. It does not establish answerability, current law, legal applicability or specialist acceptance.
